intro: Draft league team plan. One special mon gets brought per match, the other two sit in reserve, the six normal-tier mons make up the rest of the roster. Budget is a per-mon ceiling from the auction, if a mon goes over it, pivot straight to the listed alt. [test-edit]

specials.notes: core sun/phys-spam piece, pivot to Arceus if it goes over budget
Galarian form specifically, in for Defiant

normals.notes: keeps Coalossal pairing open, more versatile than the alt
fat ground support, anti-offense with Glimmora

conditional.notes: only drafted if Groudon is secured, sun team piece
fallback core with Dragapult if Groudon is unavailable/banned
not necessary, cheese option if needed

variations: sun — Groudon + Lilligant-Hisui, rest of the roster as support
Coalossal line — Coalossal + Dragapult, the fallback if Groudon doesn't come through
